items.title: CETaS commentary: AI agents are changing influence operations
items.summary_en: A CETaS commentary (the Turing's security centre) by Sam Stockwell and Cannelle Roumanie-Dalal looks at how AI agents are changing online influence operations. Only a search snippet was seen, so findings are not summarised.
items.notes: Exact day and article URL not verified; snippet only.

items.title: Turing call for proposals on non-terrestrial network vulnerabilities (closes 27 Oct 2026)
items.summary_en: The Turing has an open call for proposals titled 'Vulnerabilities and Mitigation in Non-Terrestrial Networks'. According to the search listing, it closes at 16:00 on 27 October 2026.
items.notes: Funding call, not a research result. Publication date unknown; page not fetched.

items.title: Turing and Birmingham AI model labels individual satellite components in radar imagery (just before the window)
items.summary_en: According to a secondary report, a Turing and University of Birmingham model segments parts such as solar panels, thrusters and antennas in sub-terahertz ISAR radar images and keeps tracking a part that is briefly hidden. It is described as research-stage.
items.notes: Turing's own post reportedly dated 9 Oct, one day before window; primary page not opened. Not peer-reviewed in this evidence.

coverage_note: Weak coverage. turing.ac.uk unreachable (DNS); no confirmed primary item inside window. Before-window items left out: 71 Enrichment PhD students (8 Oct), three new trustees (5 Oct), frontier AI risks agenda report (23 Sep). Re-check turing.ac.uk/news and cetas.turing.ac.uk.
